from __future__ import annotations
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, time
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright, TimeoutError as PlaywrightTimeoutError

BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:8091'
OUT = Path('/tmp/chg100-verify-CbL3wy/exact')
SHOT = OUT / 'screenshots'
SHOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

class CheckFailure(Exception):
    pass

def must(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise CheckFailure(message)

def settle(page):
    page.wait_for_selector('main,[role=main]', timeout=10000)
    page.wait_for_timeout(350)

def wait_body(page, text, timeout=5000):
    page.wait_for_function('(needle) => document.body.innerText.includes(needle)', arg=text, timeout=timeout)

def wait_results(page, expected, timeout=5000):
    page.wait_for_function(
        '(n) => document.querySelectorAll(\\'.cui-search-result\\').length === n',
        arg=expected, timeout=timeout,
    )

def search_ids(page):
    return page.locator('.cui-search-result:visible').evaluate_all(\"els => els.map(e => (e.innerText || '').split('\\\\n')[0].trim())\")

def table_ids(page):
    return page.locator('.cui-data-table .ag-center-cols-container .ag-row:visible').evaluate_all(
        \"els => els.map(e => e.querySelector('[col-id=\\\\\\\"id\\\\\\\"]')?.innerText?.trim() || e.innerText.split('\\\\n')[0].trim())\"
    )

def select_option(page, label_text, option_text):
    field = page.locator('.cui-select').filter(has_text=label_text).first.locator('input[role=combobox]')
    must(field.count() == 1, f'{label_text} select not uniquely found')
    field.click()
    option = page.get_by_role('option', name=option_text, exact=True).last
    must(option.count() == 1, f'option {option_text"'!r} not found for {label_text!r}'"')
    option.click()
    page.wait_for_timeout(350)

def detail_text(page):
    return page.locator('.cui-pattern-slot--details').inner_text()

def audit(page):
    return page.evaluate('''() => {
      const visible = el => { const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(), s=getComputedStyle(el); return r.width>1&&r.height>1&&s.display"'!=='"'none'&&s.visibility"'!=='"'hidden'; };
      const named = el => (el.getAttribute('aria-label')||el.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')||el.innerText||el.value||el.title||'').trim();
      const interactive=[...document.querySelectorAll('button,a[href],input,select,textarea,[role=button],[role=combobox],[tabindex]')].filter(visible);
      const missing=interactive.filter(el=>el.getAttribute('aria-hidden')"'!=='"'true' && "'!el.disabled && el.tabIndex>=0 && !named(el));
      const focus = document.activeElement;
      const fs = focus ? getComputedStyle(focus) : null;
      const slots=[...document.querySelectorAll('"'.cui-pattern-slot')].filter(visible).map(el=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();return {aria:el.getAttribute('aria-label'),x:r.x,right:r.right,w:r.width};});
      const p=document.querySelector('.cui-pattern'); const pr=p?.getBoundingClientRect();
      return {
        viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight,dpr:devicePixelRatio},
        theme:document.documentElement.dataset.theme||'',
        reducedMotion:matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches,
        horizontalOverflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>document.documentElement.clientWidth+1,
        documentScroll:{width:document.documentElement.scrollWidth,clientWidth:document.documentElement.clientWidth},
        missingAccessibleNames:missing.map(el=>({tag:el.tagName,role:el.getAttribute('role'),aria:el.getAttribute('aria-label'),classes:(el.className||'').toString().slice(0,160)})),
        codeCopy:[...document.querySelectorAll('.nicegui-code-copy')].filter(visible).map(el=>({aria:el.getAttribute('aria-label'),title:el.title,text:(el.innerText||'').trim()})),
        internalSelectFocusTargets:[...document.querySelectorAll('.cui-select .q-select__focus-target')].filter(visible).map(el=>({aria:el.getAttribute('aria-label'),label:el.closest('.cui-select')?.querySelector('.q-field__native')?.getAttribute('aria-label'),value:el.value})),
        slotsWithinPattern:"'!!(p&&slots.every(s=>s.x>=pr.x-1&&s.right<=pr.right+1)),
        focus:{tag:focus?.tagName||'"'',aria:focus?.getAttribute('aria-label')||'',text:(focus?.innerText||focus?.value||'').trim().slice(0,80),visibleRing:"'!!(fs&&(fs.outlineStyle!=='"'none'||fs.boxShadow"'!=='"'none'))},
        mobileNavTriggerVisible:"'!![...document.querySelectorAll('"'button')].find(el=>visible(el)&&el.getAttribute('aria-label')==='Open navigation'),
        desktopSidebarVisible:"'!![...document.querySelectorAll('"'.cui-app-sidebar:not(.q-drawer)')].find(visible),
      };
    }''')

def focus_trace(page, count=12):
    trace=[]
    for _ in range(count):
        page.keyboard.press('Tab')
        trace.append(page.evaluate('''() => { const e=document.activeElement; const s=e?getComputedStyle(e):null; return {tag:e?.tagName||'',aria:e?.getAttribute('aria-label')||'',text:(e?.innerText||e?.value||'').trim().slice(0,80),visibleRing:"'!!(s&&(s.outlineStyle!=='"'none'||s.boxShadow"'!=='"'none'))}; }'''))
    return trace

def capture(page, name, manifest):
    path = SHOT / f'{name}.png'
    page.screenshot(path=str(path), full_page=True)
    manifest[path.name] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

report = {
    'base_url': BASE,
    'browser': {'engine':'chromium', 'executable':'/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome', 'version': None},
    'scenarios': [],
    'artifacts': {},
    'zoom_200_percent': {'status':'BLOCKED', 'detail':'CUA exposed no browser provider/window; Playwright headless has no authentic browser chrome zoom control. CSS/device-scale emulation was not substituted.'},
}

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True, executable_path='/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome')
    report['browser']['version'] = browser.version
    scenario_defs = [
        ('desktop-light', 1440, 900, 'light'),
        ('mobile-dark', 390, 844, 'dark'),
    ]
    for scenario_name, width, height, color_scheme in scenario_defs:
        context = browser.new_context(
            viewport={'width': width, 'height': height},
            device_scale_factor=1,
            color_scheme=color_scheme,
            reduced_motion='reduce',
        )
        for route_name, route in [('search','/studio/pattern%3Asearch'), ('data_explorer','/studio/pattern%3Adata_explorer')]:
            page = context.new_page()
            console_errors=[]; page_errors=[]; failed_requests=[]; bad_responses=[]
            page.on('console', lambda msg, bag=console_errors: bag.append({'type':msg.type,'text':msg.text}) if msg.type=='error' else None)
            page.on('pageerror', lambda exc, bag=page_errors: bag.append(str(exc)))
            page.on('requestfailed', lambda req, bag=failed_requests: bag.append({'url':req.url,'failure':str(req.failure)}))
            page.on('response', lambda resp, bag=bad_responses: bag.append({'url':resp.url,'status':resp.status,'type':resp.request.resource_type}) if resp.status>=400 and resp.request.resource_type not in {'image','font'} else None)
            scenario = {'scenario':scenario_name,'route':route,'status':'PASS','observations':{},'audit_initial':None,'audit_final':None,'console_errors':console_errors,'page_errors':page_errors,'failed_requests':failed_requests,'bad_responses':bad_responses}
            try:
                response=page.goto(BASE+route, wait_until='domcontentloaded', timeout=30000)
                settle(page)
                must(response is not None and response.status==200, f'HTTP expected 200, got {response.status if response else None}')
                scenario['observations']['http_status']=response.status
                scenario['observations']['url']=page.url
                scenario['audit_initial']=audit(page)
                capture(page, f'{scenario_name}-{route_name}-initial', report['artifacts'])
                trace = focus_trace(page, 12)
                scenario['observations']['keyboard_focus_trace']=trace
                scenario['observations']['keyboard_focus_reachable']=any(item['tag'] not in {'','BODY','HTML'} for item in trace)
                scenario['observations']['keyboard_focus_visible']=any(item['visibleRing'] for item in trace)

                if route_name == 'search':
                    q=page.get_by_label('Search lots, tools, or recipes').first
                    must(q.count()==1, 'search query control missing')
                    initial_ids=search_ids(page)
                    initial_summary=page.locator('.cui-pattern-slot--data').inner_text().split('\\n')[0]
                    must(initial_ids==['LOT-240901','LOT-240902','LOT-240903','LOT-240904','LOT-240905','LOT-240906','LOT-240907','LOT-240908'], f'initial ETCH result set mismatch: {initial_ids}')
                    must(initial_summary=='8 results for “ETCH” · Status: Any status', f'initial summary mismatch: {initial_summary"'!r}'"')
                    scenario['observations']['initial']={'summary':initial_summary,'ids':initial_ids}

                    q.fill('NO_MATCH_987'); page.wait_for_timeout(700)
                    no_ids=search_ids(page)
                    no_text=page.locator('.cui-pattern-slot--data').inner_text()
                    no_state=page.locator('.cui-pattern-slot--data').get_by_text('No matching lots, tools, or recipes', exact=True)
                    capture(page, f'{scenario_name}-search-no-match', report['artifacts'])
                    must(no_ids==[], f'NO_MATCH_987 left visible results: {no_ids}')
                    must(no_state.count()==1 and no_state.is_visible(), 'canonical no-results state not visible')
                    must('0 results for “NO_MATCH_987” · Status: Any status' in no_text, f'no-match summary missing or inconsistent: {no_text[:500]"'!r}'"')
                    scenario['observations']['no_match']={'visible_result_ids':no_ids,'canonical_no_results':True,'data_text':no_text[:400]}

                    q.fill('ETCH'); page.wait_for_timeout(700)
                    etch_ids=search_ids(page); etch_text=page.locator('.cui-pattern-slot--data').inner_text()
                    must(len(etch_ids)==8 and '8 results for “ETCH” · Status: Any status' in etch_text, f'ETCH restore mismatch: ids={etch_ids}, summary={etch_text[:120]"'!r}'"')
                    q.fill('LOT-240904'); page.wait_for_timeout(700)
                    lot_ids=search_ids(page); lot_text=page.locator('.cui-pattern-slot--data').inner_text()
                    must(lot_ids==['LOT-240904'] and '1 results for “LOT-240904” · Status: Any status' in lot_text, f'lot-only mismatch: ids={lot_ids}, summary={lot_text[:160]"'!r}'"')
                    scenario['observations']['valid_restore_and_lot']={'etch_ids':etch_ids,'lot_ids':lot_ids,'lot_summary':lot_text.split('\\n')[0]}

                    q.fill('ETCH'); page.wait_for_timeout(700)
                    select_option(page, 'Status facet', 'Alert')
                    alert_ids=search_ids(page); alert_text=page.locator('.cui-pattern-slot--data').inner_text()
                    must(alert_ids==['LOT-240904','LOT-240908'], f'ETCH+Alert result mismatch: {alert_ids}')
                    must('2 results for “ETCH” · Status: Alert' in alert_text, f'ETCH+Alert summary mismatch: {alert_text[:180]"'!r}'"')
                    scenario['observations']['alert_combo']={'ids':alert_ids,'summary':alert_text.split('\\n')[0]}

                    selected_result=page.locator('.cui-search-result').filter(has_text='LOT-240904').first
                    selected_result.click(); page.wait_for_timeout(350)
                    selected_detail=detail_text(page)
                    must('LOT-240904' in selected_detail and 'No result selected' not in selected_detail, f'selected search context did not follow LOT-240904: {selected_detail"'!r}'"')
                    q.fill('LOT-240908'); page.wait_for_timeout(700)
                    hidden_ids=search_ids(page); cleared_detail=detail_text(page)
                    must(hidden_ids==['LOT-240908'], f'filter-to-908 result mismatch: {hidden_ids}')
                    must('No result selected' in cleared_detail and 'LOT-240904' not in cleared_detail, f'filtered-out selection did not clear truthfully: {cleared_detail"'!r}'"')
                    scenario['observations']['selection_clear_on_disappear']={'selected_detail':selected_detail,'after_filter_ids':hidden_ids,'after_filter_detail':cleared_detail}

                    q.fill('ETCH'); page.wait_for_timeout(700)
                    select_option(page, 'Status facet', 'Any status')
                    restored_ids=search_ids(page)
                    must(len(restored_ids)==8, f'final search restore failed: {restored_ids}')
                    scenario['observations']['final_restore_ids']=restored_ids
                    # Focus restoration on a real select popup: Escape returns focus to the select target.

                else:
                    sidebar=page.locator('.cui-app-sidebar:not(.q-drawer)').first
                    trigger=page.get_by_role('button', name='Open navigation').first
                    scenario['observations']['responsive_shell']={'desktop_sidebar_visible':sidebar.count()==1 and sidebar.is_visible(),'mobile_trigger_visible':trigger.count()>0 and trigger.is_visible()}
                    must(sidebar.count()==1 and sidebar.is_visible(), 'desktop sidebar missing')
                    must(not (trigger.count()>0 and trigger.is_visible()), 'mobile navigation trigger visible on desktop')

                scenario['audit_final']=audit(page)

            finally:
                capture(page, f'{scenario_name}-{route_name}-final', report['artifacts'])

}
